verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Paddle ships an MCP server, agent skills, SDKs, OpenAPI spec, and Postman collection, and even integrates with third-party AI CLIs like Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex — but nowhere is there a Paddle-branded CLI tool for direct API/dashboard interaction. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability (a CLI is plausible for a payments platform) makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.
